title: Ion Wastes: Narrative Mystery

foundation.history: The drifting relay station was built to protect shielded relay coils, but electromagnetic storms interrupted its stewardship.

premise: Tavi Rene, a investigator, must reconstruct an erased civic record using evidence synthesis while electromagnetic storms threatens the drifting relay station.
central_conflict: a record-forging council seeks control of shielded relay coils; residents want accountable access.

plot_beats.name: Arrival
plot_beats.cause: electromagnetic storms isolates the drifting relay station
plot_beats.effect: Local routes and witnesses become inaccessible

plot_beats.name: The bargain
plot_beats.cause: a record-forging council offers privileged access to shielded relay coils
plot_beats.effect: The player must decide whether to share information

plot_beats.name: The remedy
plot_beats.cause: The production plan determines who controls the restored system
plot_beats.effect: Faction trust changes the final public arrangement

endings.consequence: Stewardship passes to a representative public council
Resident cooperatives operate the recovered infrastructure
The essential route survives with unresolved governance debts
